title: GTA 6 Official Album Announced with CD and Vinyl Pre-Orders
description: Rockstar Games and Atlantic Records have officially announced the GTA 6 album, now available for pre-order on CD and multiple vinyl editions.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Official Album Announced: Pre-Orders Open Now via Atlantic Records

Rockstar Games has officially announced the upcoming release of the official GTA 6 album, bringing exciting news for both gaming enthusiasts and music lovers. Partnering with Atlantic Records, the publisher has made the highly anticipated soundtrack available for pre-order, giving fans a tangible piece of the next generation of the franchise.

Music has always been a fundamental pillar of the Grand Theft Auto experience, defining the cultural vibe of Rockstar's satirical open worlds. Following in the footsteps of legendary soundtracks from previous titles, the GTA 6 album promises to set a new standard for gaming audio.

### Pre-Order Formats and Streaming Options

According to the official announcement, fans can purchase the physical album in several formats through the official site:

* **CD Edition**: Perfect for traditional music collectors.
* **Standard Vinyl Edition**: A timeless choice for vinyl enthusiasts.
* **Limited Edition Vinyl**: A special variant designed for dedicated collectors looking for unique packaging.

In addition to physical formats, digital-first fans can already pre-save the album across major music streaming platforms, including Apple Music, Spotify, and more, ensuring instant access the moment the tracks drop.

### Track Reveal and Expectations

Alongside the pre-order launch, several tracks from the album have been revealed. While the full tracklist remains under wraps for now, the initial selection highlights the diverse musical direction and atmospheric immersion that players have come to expect from the GTA universe. As pre-orders roll out, the community is already speculating on how these tracks will integrate into the game's iconic radio stations and narrative moments.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar Games understands better than anyone how crucial a killer soundtrack is to open-world immersion. Offering both standard and limited edition vinyls alongside streaming pre-saves shows a deep appreciation for physical collectors and modern listeners alike. This album is shaping up to be an essential companion piece to the biggest release of the decade.
